name: gto-pr-review
description: Multi-agent PR review, risk gating & business-impact mapping — run it on your uncommitted changes without leaving the editor.

commands.title: GTO: Set Personal Git Provider Token
GTO: Show Issues on This Line

gto.backendUrl.description: Base URL of the GTO Pull Request Review Framework backend (no trailing slash).

gto.gitProvider.description: Which provider 'Post to PR' and 'Approve PR' target — should match the backend's own GIT_PROVIDER. Not used by Analyze Changes/Branch, which never talk to a provider directly.

enumDescriptions: Print the Fast-preset gate result before a push, but never refuse it.
Refuse the push (non-zero exit) when the gate comes back BLOCK.
gto.gitHookMode.description: Behavior of the pre-push hook installed via 'GTO: Install Git Hook'. Only takes effect in a repo where the hook is installed.

enumDescriptions: code_analysis + security only — fastest, catches the sharpest issues. Recommended for the editor loop.
Core review + risk gate (code_analysis, security, dependency, test_coverage, interface, risk).
All ~22 agents — the same full-depth review as a PR submission. Slow for an editor loop; use sparingly.
gto.agentPreset.description: Which agents to run when analyzing from the editor.

gto.autoAnalyzeOnSave.description: Automatically run 'GTO: Analyze Changes' (uncommitted diff, no priorities prompt) shortly after you save a file. Off by default — this makes an LLM-backed backend call on every save.

gto.modelPreset.description: Which admin-configured backend model preset to use (see the 'GTO: Select Model' command — easier than editing this directly). Empty = the backend's own default model. This is the recommended way to pick a model on a shared multi-user backend: no credential ever leaves the server. Takes priority over gto.modelProvider below when set.

enumDescriptions: Use whatever the backend is configured with (default — leaves every run unchanged).
Azure OpenAI — needs gto.modelBaseUrl set to your Azure resource endpoint.
Ollama (local) — needs gto.modelBaseUrl, e.g. http://localhost:11434. No API key needed.
Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (org-deployed Llama, vLLM, LM Studio, Groq, Together AI, Fireworks, ...) — needs gto.modelBaseUrl.
gto.modelProvider.description: ADVANCED — a manual override for a personal backend with your own separate provider/endpoint. Ignored whenever gto.modelPreset is set. On a shared team backend, use 'GTO: Select Model' (gto.modelPreset) instead — that one needs no credential from you at all. Leave empty to use the backend's own configuration.

gto.modelName.description: ADVANCED — model name for gto.modelProvider, e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'gpt-4o', 'llama3.2', or your own deployment name. Ignored when gto.modelProvider is empty or gto.modelPreset is set.

gto.modelBaseUrl.description: ADVANCED — endpoint URL, only relevant alongside gto.modelProvider (azure_openai/ollama/custom need it; anthropic/openai ignore it). Leave empty on a shared backend with MODEL_PRESETS configured — presets already point at the right endpoint server-side.

gto.modelApiVersion.description: ADVANCED — API version string, only used for azure_openai (e.g. '2024-08-01-preview').

gto.excludePatterns.description: Glob patterns (.gitignore-flavored — a pattern with no '/' matches at any depth) for files to leave out of every analysis, on top of what .gitignore already hides. Defaults cover common IDE/tooling noise plus build/dependency output for JS/TS (node_modules, lock files), Java/Kotlin (target, .gradle, *.class), Python (__pycache__, venv, .pytest_cache, egg-info), .NET (obj — not bin, which some projects use for real shipped code), Go/PHP/Ruby (vendor), and Swift (.build, DerivedData). Applies to both 'Analyze Changes' and 'Analyze Branch...'.
